title: Node Health
summary: Your private home for every lab result
content: Node Health: Your private home for every lab result | Product Hunt Launching today Node Health Launching today Your private home for every lab result 45 followers Your private home for every lab result 45 followers Visit website Health & Fitness • Medical Lab results arrive as printouts, PDFs and in portals that differ by provider — and scatter further when you switch labs or move. Node Health brings them into one place you own, your phone: scan, upload, or type in any report, and 150+ biomarkers are matched to reference ranges personalized to your age, sex and, where relevant, life stage. What's different: a doctor-reviewed biomarker database instead of AI-generated content, data encrypted on your iPhone, and core tracking that is free forever. It started with a personal frustration: every lab sends results in a different format and here in Germany even mostly on paper. One sends a printout, another a PDF, another locks them in a portal. Change providers, or move to another city or country, and your health history is suddenly scattered across systems that don't talk to each other. We wanted one place where all of our results live, that you fully own, no matter where the blood was drawn. So we built Node Health: 📄 Any report, any provider — scan with your camera, upload a PDF, paste raw text, or enter values manually. We extract the values in a standardised unit for easy comparison and drawing of trends (via a Chart). 🎯 Tailored to your biology — reference ranges personalized to your age, sex and, where relevant, life stage, from a doctor-reviewed database. If your report includes the lab's own reference ranges, we extract those automatically too, so you can compare them side by side. 📈 Trends over time — one blood test is a snapshot; years of them is a story. We also allow storage of all your medical documents in one place, encrypted and if wanted
